headlines.text: Flash back to 2022, when the inaugural ROH Women's World Title was crowned as Mercedes Martinez vs. Deonna Purrazzo went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.80. A unification match on Purrazzo's AEW in-ring debut ? a hard-fought battle that saw Martinez lock in the dragon sleeper for the tap-out win, becoming the sole, undisputed ROH Women's World Champion just days after AEW officially completed its purchase of the promotion.
Rewind to 2022, when it was The Butcher and The Blade & Angelico's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.25.
It was 2022 when W. Morrissey kicked off their AEW journey against Wardlow, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.29.

secondaries.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Rey Fenix vs. Dante Martin locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 7.65 ? a solid showing.
